Definition: to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to
BiblicalUsage: 1) to give to drink, irrigate, drink, water, cause to drink water; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to water, irrigate; 1a2) to water, give drink to; 1b) (Pual) to be watered; 1c) (Niphal) variant
